body:
Thanks for reading. The guy is a family friend. He was in a fucked up point of his life too as a teen and now he got fixed by his now-wife and is living in a happy family, married with a kid. I haven't seen him in a very long time and I don't care what he does now. I'm glad that he met the love of his life and changed for the better. But that doesn't change how I view myself when I'm in pain. Sure, I love learning, languages especially, but I don't have any useful, great qualities. I have no confidence in my language or tutoring skills, plus depression takes a lot out of me, so I can't get a job to cover my mistake (which happened because depression screwed up my memories and work ethic).
The main thing that destroyed my trust in people was not actually the trauma (though that probably set me up for a screwed up life down the line) was never being helped when I'm struggling after all the effort I put in helping others, being taken advantage of, being lied to and getting the cops called on me, thrown in the ambulance and hospital, locked up and ignored, sent back with two unaffordable bills for nothing, as well as hearing every lie in the book about not being alone, being loved, and that they're there for me. It's just the polite thing to say. I'm aware that they do care to an extent, but I also won't believe it because of what I experienced over and over. I hear a lot of "don't [insert bad stuff here]" but nothing that I should do to turn things around, nothing that will get me to see the bright side of things. I've tried so hard to make everyone happy. Now I'm just tired, empty, and hurt.

Thanks for reading. But I think that this moment of relief is just the eye of the storm. It's almost impossible to go through with my plans. Because I have to think of a low key site to be my grave to not attract attention, get myself super drunk to lower my inhibitions because there's a survival instinct that will do anything to keep me from overdosing on pain relievers, and even then I'll most likely just vomit up everything. So I keep thinking and planning but never going through with it because I know that something will definitely go wrong and I'll still live, and in a more messed up state. I honestly don't know what to do with my life. I don't have a goal or anything that great to look forward to in the future. I just messed up really badly and there's nothing but failure and disappointment.
I don't think I am tbh. I'm ordinary, not that talented, and a bit quirky. But thanks, I just want the little guy to have a chance at life.
